tests.description: Reference run: WRF 4.8 real-terrain simulation of data/eqwefic/notes/gwdo_real_reference_run.md (Last Chance Gulch d01, Colorado Rockies, 8.1 km, 150 x 180 x 50, dt = 45 s, gwd_opt = 1 with ELVMAX supplied by WPS util/compute_gwdo.py -- without it GWDO is silently off everywhere, FORTRAN_BUGS B17). Step 2 = 2012-06-25 12:01Z, global row j = 61 across the Sangre de Cristo range, tile column 30 of the dump that starts at i = 39. Drag is ON (ELVMAX = 1770 m, var = 54 m); wind-rose sector 3 (south-west), aspect ratio od = 1.59, Froude number 0.42, launch stress 0.30 Pa. Above the reference level kref = 5 it has 8 saturating levels, 24 no-wave-breaking levels and a flow-blocking layer, so one column exercises the whole scheme. Reference build: the real64 (kind_phys = real64) replay of the same dumped row through kernels/gwdo_diag_driver of WRF fork branch earthsciml-instrumented-gwdo, with the six scalar constants g, cp, R_d, R_v, eps_1 and pi supplied at binary64 precision instead of WRF's real32 module values (gwdo_real/mkflat64.py). They are subroutine arguments, not internal parameters, so that is what a double-precision kernel reference means for this scheme, and it is exactly what lib/wrf_constants.esm carries; promoting them flips no branch on any of the 140 dumped rows and moves the outputs by a median 2.7e-8 of the row maximum. Every assertion is on an algebraic observed at t = 0 and the document declares no ODE state, so the empty time_span is a single static evaluation.

The convexity factor is correspondingly saturated at 0.986 and the non-hydrostatic correction has almost cancelled the stress, 1 + nhd = 5.1e-3, leaving a launch stress of only 5e-4 Pa. _note: `kblk` is asserted at zero tolerance: it is a level index, and one disagreement is a different blocking depth, not a lost digit. `fbdcd` is asserted only in the regimes that actually block: the Fortran computes the form-drag coefficient inside `if (kblk /= 0)` and leaves it undefined otherwise, so the diagnostic build has nothing to compare against there, while the .esm forms it unconditionally from the aspect ratio -- the same situation as coefm and xlinv one stage up. `taup` is the TOTAL interface stress, wave plus blocking, i.e. the Fortran's `taup` array as the tendency stage receives it.
